Non-Goal 1 respected: engine.Converged and engine.ConsecutiveClean still walk every role's rows and are severity-blind, and --check still branches on converged alone. Nothing in this release makes the streak role- or severity-scoped.

Non-Goal 3 respected: severity is read, never validated. An unrecognised value is graded blocking and bucketed as unrecognised; no sink refuses a row for its severity, in contrast to the category enum which parseAuditRows does reject.
